feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Microsoft confirms all services are restored after global outage
articles.summary: Microsoft has said that all services have been fully restored after a global outage which affected the NHS, police, schools and other services across the UK.

articles.title: Former SAS chief blames state for breaking 'moral contract' with soldiers
articles.summary: A former commanding officer of the SAS blamed the state for breaking a "moral contract" between the country and its top soldiers by setting up an inquiry into war crimes which has failed to reach conclusions four years on.

articles.title: US asked if Ukraine would give up parts of Donbas for NATO membership, Zelenskyy says
articles.summary: The US has asked for the first time whether Ukraine would withdraw from parts of the Donbas region if Kyiv were admitted to NATO, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

articles.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold unprecedented meeting, White House says
articles.summary: The leaders of the US, China and Russia will hold an unprecedented meeting on the sidelines of a major economic summit, the White House has said.

articles.title: Goalkeeper given 12-game ban for fatal collision with Tenerife striker
articles.summary: Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been suspended for 12 games after an on-field collision that resulted in the death of Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel.

articles.title: EU leaders choose team for Ukraine peace talks after months of wavering
articles.summary: British representatives will be part of a team representing Europe in Ukraine peace talks.

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six, health ministry says
articles.summary: An Israeli airstrike on a Palestinian hospital has killed at least six and wounded 28, Gaza's Health Ministry said.
